name: field-colours
does: Colours the headings of the fields a course names as hardest (BDK: Pharmacologic category teal, Common indications pink), as text colour only, in the panes of feature tabs: any element there marked data-field="<field>" (drug-list-tab's column headings; compare-tab's row headers once that module marks them). Dark colours only under the theme module's dark theme. Display only; reads no course data and stores nothing.
source: BDK assets/style.css lines 367-383 (the colours) and assets/app.js line 2598 (th.k-cat, th.k-ind on the Drug list headings), at 05c36c3; first in BDK bf91dc0

fields.about: [[field, light colour, dark colour], ...]: each heading marked data-field="<field>" in a feature tab's pane takes the light colour, or the dark colour under the theme module's dark theme; colours as #rgb or #rrggbb (BDK's)
